label: Enable Kineticle
description: Master switch for all Kineticle effects. Configuration is saved by Core.

label: Chassis mass multiplier
description: Persistent 1–100x alternative chassis collision mass, capped at 100,000 kg. 1 = vanilla.

label: Include motorcycles
description: Allow Kineticle effects while V drives motorcycles.

label: Mechanical damage protection
description: Zero the computed vehicle hit values for V's actively driven road vehicle.

label: Body deformation restoration
description: Reset the damage grid after the vanilla destruction callback.

label: Glass restoration
description: Reset glass after the vanilla destruction callback.
